summary: Grab Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its consolidation of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (Superbank) after Singtel Alpha Investments transfers its Superbank shares to GXS Bank, Grab's digital banking joint venture with Singtel. Grab's combined direct and indirect shareholding in Superbank will increase to over 50%, leading to consolidation into Grab's Financial Services segment. The transfer is expected to complete in May 2026. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. This is a strategic consolidation in Indonesia's fintech space. Watch for regulatory approvals and integration risks.
